channel.description: Recent content in Billing on Sujith Quintelier

item.title: github: Set an expiration date for individual user budgets
item.description:
GitHub now lets you set an optional expiration date on an individual user budget. When the date is reached, GitHub automatically removes the budget; the feature is generally available.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Purchase order mapping available in Microsoft Marketplace
item.description:
Microsoft Marketplace purchase order mapping is now generally available. It lets organizations allocate Microsoft invoices, including Marketplace purchases, to support accounting and reconciliation of cloud and AI spend.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Copilot model access update for GitHub Team plans
item.description:
GitHub updated how Copilot model access is determined for users with seats in more than one organization. The change is intended to keep billing and governance aligned.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Upcoming changes to GitHub Copilot policies and billing
item.description:
GitHub says three upcoming changes are coming to Copilot policies and billing. The post is a notice to review the updates, but the provided excerpt does not include the actual policy or billing details.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Apps can now access enterprise billing data
item.description:
GitHub Apps can now be granted access to enterprise billing data by enterprise owners. The app configuration flow now includes an enterprise billing permission that can be selected when creating or updating an app.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub billing in India now supports automatic recurring payments
item.description:
GitHub billing in India now supports automatic recurring payments for monthly and annual bills when using eligible saved credit cards. The change uses a payment mandate for recurring charges.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Kimi K3 is now available in GitHub Copilot
item.description:
GitHub has resumed rolling out Kimi K3 in GitHub Copilot. The model is billed at provider list pricing under usage-based billing.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Retiring the Copilot Billing Preview app
item.description:
GitHub has retired the Copilot Billing Preview app and it is no longer available. Copilot spend can now be reviewed and managed directly in GitHub billing settings.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: AI credit pools for cost centers in the billing UI
item.description:
GitHub Billing UI now lets you manage a cost center’s AI credit pool directly when creating or editing cost centers. Before this change, that configuration was only available through another interface.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Copilot users can now see AI credits used per billing cycle
item.description:
Copilot Business and Copilot Enterprise users can now view how many AI credits they have used in the current billing cycle, even if they do not have an individual budget. The usage count is available in GitHub Copilot usage.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Per-user budgets for cost centers in the billing UI
item.description:
GitHub Enterprise Cloud now supports creating per-user budgets for cost centers directly in the billing UI. Enterprise admins can manage these user-level budgets alongside cost centers and budgets in one place.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Copilot Billing Preview app will be retired on August 3
item.description:
GitHub will retire the Copilot Billing Preview app on August 3, 2026. Users who rely on it for Copilot spend review are directed to use built-in GitHub visibility instead.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Cost centers now support enterprise teams
item.description:
GitHub cost centers now support adding enterprise teams as resources, so usage can be attributed according to your team structure. This update extends cost attribution for enterprises beyond individual resources.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: AI credits consumed per user now in the Copilot usage metrics API
item.description:
The Copilot usage metrics API now includes per-user AI credits consumed per day. The new data is derived from the same AI credits consumption source used by the usage-based billing API.

  • Source: GitHub
